documents.summary: A living record of what VaultSpark Studios is building in the open — games, tools, worlds, and the studio intelligence behind them.
documents.body: VaultSpark Studios Independent AI & Synthetic Intelligence (SI) studio building browser games, intelligence tools, and worlds. The Vault is sparked. From Artificial Intelligence to Synthetic Intelligence. Terminology - AI (Artificial Intelligence): models and established AI technology. - Agentic AI: models operating through agents and tools. - Synthetic Intelligence (SI): composed systems that integrate models, agents, memory, tools, software, infrastructure and people. This is what VaultSpark Studios builds. - Super Intelligence (SI): the term U.S. federal executive agencies use for AI since the 2026-09-29 executive order, and a future capability category. VaultSpark Studios does not claim
